name: codex-autoaccept
description: Toggle automatic approval for Codex IDE requests and integrated-terminal CLI sessions.

commands.title: Codex Auto-Accept: Install / Repair Codex GUI Integration
Codex Auto-Accept: Restore Original Codex Extension

codexAutoAccept.enabled.description: Auto-approve recognized Codex prompts. OFF by default. Read from user settings only.

codexAutoAccept.terminalEnabled.description: Watch newly started Codex CLI shell executions.

codexAutoAccept.guiEnabled.description: Approve command/file requests after GUI integration is installed.

codexAutoAccept.approveFileChanges.description: Allow file-change approvals. File approval requests may omit the diff, so command deny rules cannot validate their contents.

codexAutoAccept.dryRun.description: Log decisions without sending keys or approval responses.

codexAutoAccept.allowPatterns.description: Optional regular-expression allowlist. Empty allows recognized requests unless denied. Nonempty also restricts file request metadata.

codexAutoAccept.denyPatterns.description: Additional deny regular expressions; built-in destructive-command rules always apply. Invalid patterns stop auto-approval.

codexAutoAccept.terminalColumns.description: Shadow terminal dimension. Match your integrated terminal size for reliable ANSI screen reconstruction.

codexAutoAccept.terminalRows.description: Shadow terminal dimension. Match your integrated terminal size for reliable ANSI screen reconstruction.
